Karlach tells the player that if the tieflings are in HAV Dammon might be there too after Mol appears in the checkpoint dialog.

Dialog from Dammon in the Act3, when we meet him while in his shop.
context: Karlach and the player encounter Dammon in either Haven or Lower City; depending on prior choices this may be their first or a follow‑up meeting. Dammon is a former weaponsmith who recognizes Karlach’s infernal engine and claims he knows how to upgrade it, but he needs a piece of infernal iron to craft an insulating chamber that could let her physically touch people. Karlach is overjoyed and impatient to hunt down the metal, while Dammon is cautious—he gives both “good” and “bad” news and offers to show the party likely places to look. In the Haven state he may be a rescued tiefling renting rooms who can trade and forge hellish gear if you bring the right material.
